ios.desc:
Chorus Sleep: Your All-in-One Solution for Better Sleep

Chorus Sleep is an evidence-based program that helps 80% of people sleep better and wake up feeling refreshed.
“I’ve been using Chorus Sleep and WOW! I’m out like a light.” - Sheila K.
Sleep is our superpower. With it, we can achieve our full potential. Without it, everything falls apart. Want to reach your full potential? Give Chorus a try.
Chorus Sleep combines everything you need for better sleep into one simple place. Whether you’ve had trouble sleeping for years or just need help once a week, we’ve got you covered.

WHAT YOU’LL LOVE:
- Soothing soundscapes
- Relaxation techniques
- Evidence-based education
- Snoring solutions
- Insomnia support
- Sleep Apnea testing and treatment
- Pediatric sleep support
- Tailored advice for your unique challenges

Choose self-guided or coach-assisted options - whatever works best for you.
More than just another sleep app, Chorus Sleep provides all the tools you need to transform your nights and energize your days in one simple place.
We offer a budget-friendly option for ongoing and long-term support.
Download our app today and start your journey to improved rest and brighter days.

BENEFITS:
- 80% of people improve their sleep
- 44% faster time to fall asleep
- 30% reduction in nighttime awakenings

Our comprehensive solution addresses a wide range of sleep challenges:
- Anxiety and racing thoughts
- Environmental disturbances
- Baby and child related sleep issues
- Sleep apnea and snoring And many more!

With Chorus Sleep, you’ll have a personalized sleep coach in your pocket, ready to guide you towards restful nights and energized days. Don’t just dream of better sleep – achieve it with our science-backed approach.

WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING:
“I slept like a baby!” - Avani P.
“I used to have trouble quieting my mind, but Chorus stops all of that in its tracks so I can sleep great!” - Taylor G.
“I fell asleep so fast… it was amazing!” - Kelsie D
“Chorus helped me skip my sleep aids and I slept so soundly through the night!” - Anonymous
“I’ve been using Chorus Sleep and WOW! I’m out like a light.” - Sheila K.

SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS:
Chorus Sleep Premium is offered an auto-renewing monthly subscription and an auto-renewing 6-month subscription which features a free trial (you won’t be charged until your free trial is over). The subscription offers full access to all audio sessions and sounds, written content such as lessons and essentials.
